claude_result_text: The geometry has been updated to make the four engines more prominent and well-spaced by increasing their size (cowl radius and length) and slightly adjusting their vertical and forward positions relative to the wings. This should address the judge's observation about only two visible engines appearing, as larger pods with clear separation between inboard and outboard positions are much easier to distinguish in both perspective and profile views. The nacelles now have a more realistic high-bypass size and a more distinct layout that reflects the iconic Boeing 747 configuration, ensuring all four engines are clearly visible across various viewing angles.
